title: ITSP.10.171 media markings and transport outside controlled areas need traceable evidence
remediation: The sponsor media transport authority approves distribution markings, handling caveats and transport safeguards for assessed media. Verify markings on a representative item and sample transport outside controlled areas with sender and recipient accountability, agreed protective handling, and a dated custody and delivery record. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect the marking rules and sanitized example with approved transport safeguards and documented custody and delivery
